instruct:
A female voice. Accent: Scandinavian Ballard, indignant. Mrs. Gunderson, who bought a vacuum cleaner from Pike.

sample_text: Operator, ring Mr. Harold Pike's room. I know he's staying here. Mr. Pike, this is Mrs. Gunderson. You sold me a Whirlwind Deluxe on Tuesday.
